title: Observe
description: Observe layer (spec-v1.0: 'Observable result'). The observation result, recorded under Observation First: record observations, not explanations. There is deliberately no field for reasons, interpretations, or explanations; additionalProperties is false so that none can be added.

id.description: Identifier of this observation, unique within the record stream.

event_ref.description: Id of the Event that was observed. Within a Canonical Record it must equal event.id.

observed_at.description: Time the observation was taken (RFC 3339, UTC 'Z' suffix). Not earlier than event.occurred_at.

result.description: Observed result as captured (e.g. a tool's literal output line). Not an interpretation.

outputs.description: Additional observed values as captured (e.g. exit status). Recorded verbatim.
